failure.heading: 16. A session stopped placing its messages once the window said nothing moved — 2026-10-03

observed_failure.description: An independently prompted work turn has no placement call in its public action span before the reply. The hook still gives an unchanged window.

events.text:
I added the local rule, then ran the third `/plan` pass on `.0011`. Nothing load-bearing is left open, and the ticket check is clean.

**The local rule** is L5 in [local.rules.md](local.rules.md), installed into `AGENTS.md`'s local block: *Run a Python script with `uv run --offline --no-project python <script>`.* The local block changes without a contract bump, and `inject_rules.py --check` is clean.

**What the third pass changed in the RFC:**
- **Race test:** it now goes through `declare` with `Clause` lists, because the other-writer hook lives only there. The existing interference tests that build their lines with `questions.parse` are migrated the same way.
- **One more string to rewrite:** *"changed since this line was read; read it again and declare anew"* becomes *"changed since this call read it; call it again"*.
- **`open` doesn't move the session.** The old line opened a question and stood on it in one go; now that takes two calls. The skill gets one sentence saying so.
- **Usage messages go to stderr,** so the usage tests read both output streams.
- **The session's date now moves only with `at`.** Before, every line carried an `at`, so every write refreshed it. Q1 still makes an `at` every turn, so the stale-session warning still works.
- **L5 is cited** next to your "no interpreter in the rule" decision.

**Still uncommitted:**
- the `.0011` RFC;
- the ticket and queue updates;
- the register note that you approved the amendment for v19;
- L5.

Shall I commit these and start `/implement` on `.0011`?
